metric_semantics.arithmetic_gate: Require original AND perturbed BF16/FP32 rho>=.95 and maximum of their median absolute RDM differences <=.10 times the FP32 intervention difference. Undefined/zero differences do not pass.
metric_semantics.coverage: Every registered model, poem, condition, state and pooling is required. Missing execution prevents scientific output; undefined correlations remain explicit.
metric_semantics.inference: Seeds repeat interventions on the same 24 poems; distance pairs and omissions are dependent. No p-values, confidence intervals, population-level power, or literary-usefulness claim.
metric_semantics.precision: Original and every shuffled input run in both precisions with identical inputs. FP32 promotes the same checkpoint values, not higher-precision source weights.
metric_semantics.primary: Three pragmatic effect-size criteria on FP32 mean token-shuffle RDMs; all five seed directions required. Not a significance test or semantic validation.
metric_semantics.rdm: Float64 cosine distance of saved pooled vectors; upper triangles follow ordered poem IDs, row-major i<j.
metric_semantics.rsa: Spearman after Q12 rounding distances, average ranks for ties; constants remain null with explicit status.
